item.text: The key rules are snapshot selection and lab deduplication: discharge summaries govern each encounter’s final home-medication list, while lab copies are matched by accession and test code. I’ll keep “held” distinct from “stopped,” exclude hospital-only drugs, and select the most advanced lab status before parsing its value.

item.text: The schema gives no medication-specific start dates, so I’ll omit `authoredOn` rather than use the admission or signing date as a substitute. Unreconciled home-list entries will be reported plans; clinician decisions will be orders. Lab parsing will preserve comparators and skip text-only values or unsupported units.

The mapper passes strict type-checking. The sample produces four home-medication requests and 49 distinct lab observations. I’m checking correction chains, Chicago date cutoffs, empty medication snapshots, discharge precedence, and corrected lab results with nonnumeric values.
